    F

    fat32 - Package fat32
     
    Fat32Reader - Klasse in fat32
    Fat32Reader is the main class for the FAT32 Data Recovery Tool.
    Fat32Reader() - Konstruktor für Klasse fat32.Fat32Reader
     
    fatsCount - Variable in Klasse filesystem.BootSector
    Number of FAT tables (typically 2 for FAT32)
    fatSize - Variable in Klasse filesystem.BootSector
    Size of one FAT table in sectors
    fileName - Variable in Klasse filesystem.DirectoryEntry
    Name of the file or directory (8.3 or long filename)
    fileSize - Variable in Klasse filesystem.DirectoryEntry
    Size of the file in bytes (0 for directories)
    filesystem - Package filesystem
     
    firstDataSector - Variable in Klasse filesystem.BootSector
    First sector number containing data (after reserved sectors and FATs)
    flag - Variable in Klasse masterBootRecord.PartitionEntry
    Bootable flag: 0x80 = active/bootable, 0x00 = inactive
